title: Pulp Fiction
starring: Patrick J. Adams, Emily Deschanel, Harvey Keitel
summary: Two sceptical podcasters build a devoted following by debunking conspiracy theories, only to uncover impossible inconsistencies suggesting reality is rewriting itself. When the government confirms that the world is a simulation programmed to terminate once enough people discover the truth, their movement must decide whether exposing the fiction is worth risking the destruction of everything.
